title.value: Turn saved recipes into a weekly meal plan and carts

introduction.value: A Claude Code skill using Claude in Chrome turns saved Pinterest and Instagram recipes into a plan, checks budget, then fills Whole Foods and Instacart carts after approval without checking out.

method.value: Run as /meal-planner in Claude Code with the Claude in Chrome extension, using your logged-in Pinterest, Instagram, Amazon/Whole Foods and Instacart sessions. The agent reads every saved recipe, checks the weather and pantry, and plans a gluten-free week. It prices items at Whole Foods, falls back to cheaper nearby Instacart stores, revises to fit the budget, and shows an HTML preview. You approve, then it fills the carts.

outcome.value: The source gives no measured results. It describes replacing a 1–2 hour weekly routine, and it labels the project a proof of concept.

notes.value: It needs a paid Claude plan. It relies on undocumented Pinterest and Instagram web endpoints that could change, because neither site offers a cart or saves API.

source_text.body:
Turn saved recipes into a weekly meal plan and carts
A Claude Code skill using Claude in Chrome turns saved Pinterest and Instagram recipes into a plan, checks budget, then fills Whole Foods and Instacart carts after approval without checking out.
Done with
CC
Claude Code
CH
Claude in Chrome
What they did
Run as /meal-planner in Claude Code with the Claude in Chrome extension, using your logged-in Pinterest, Instagram, Amazon/Whole Foods and Instacart sessions. The agent reads every saved recipe, checks the weather and pantry, and plans a gluten-free week. It prices items at Whole Foods, falls back to cheaper nearby Instacart stores, revises to fit the budget, and shows an HTML preview. You approve, then it fills the carts.
How it went
The source gives no measured results. It describes replacing a 1–2 hour weekly routine, and it labels the project a proof of concept.
Worth knowing
It needs a paid Claude plan. It relies on undocumented Pinterest and Instagram web endpoints that could change, because neither site offers a cart or saves API.
Try it yourself
with
Claude Code
Copy prompt
Take the recipes I saved in [Pinterest board or Instagram collection link] and pick [number] for this week's dinners for [number] people. Combine the ingredients into one shopping list, check it against my budget of [$ amount], and show me the plan. After I approve it, fill my [Whole Foods or Instacart] cart in the browser, then stop and don't check out.
Original source: https://github.com/lauriejpdx/meal-planner-agent
